simple.meaning: חֵשֶׁק (chêsheq) is a Hebrew object word meaning “delight.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Kings 9:1. The surrounding context includes kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֵשֶׁק (H2837) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חֵשֶׁק (chêsheq) / H2837 is traced through 1 Kings 9:1, 1 Kings 9:19, 2 Chronicles 8:6, Isaiah 21:4 with generated occurrence evidence.
